correction_trigger: The bounded-run contract requires an unreached determinant milestone to be a binary solvability failure even though its energy metric is indeterminate; the timeout-only recovery also omitted completed-parent and Phase-1 checkpoint states.

exposure_disclosure.selection_basis: solver execution semantics and all-parent artifact reconciliation

policy.completed_below_cap: use the terminal native checkpoint at larger caps
policy.energy_for_observed_rung: native variational checkpoint plus rotated FCIDUMP constant; no PT2
policy.interrupted_observation: execution must reach the cap and have emitted a checkpoint at or below it
policy.phase0_and_nonselected_native_checkpoint: archived but not introduced post hoc as ML variants

superseded_bundle.scope: TrimCI rung labels, eligibility, fitted models, predictions, and aggregate reports
